name: io.github.sheetrender/sheetrender-mcp
description: MCP server for SheetRender: render PDFs from templates and spreadsheet data, as a local stdio server or via the hosted endpoint at mcp.sheetrender.com.

environmentVariables.description: SheetRender API key (sr_live_...), from sheetrender.com under Settings
environmentVariables.name: SHEETRENDER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SheetRender API; defaults to https://sheetrender.com
environmentVariables.name: SHEETRENDER_API_URL

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <SheetRender API key> (sr_live_..., from sheetrender.com under Settings)
